previous_statement: Dependency-bearing bridge: depend on node 1.2.1 for the membership premise r_j in C for every j and r in C, and depend on node 1.2.2 for the coefficient premise c_j >= 0, 1-s > 0, and sum_j c_j + (1-s) = 1.
